notes.title: New year - New awards for ENDLING
notes.content:
We are only one month into 2023 and ENDLING has already received multiple awards.

Premios DeVuego 2022
The 13 nominations ENDLING had the Premios DeVuego 2022 are impressive by itself. But we feel especially honored that it won awards in the following categories:

 Best Absolute Game
 Best Music
 Best Sound
 Best Design
 Best Production

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33205595/5330ab5d53c5a61ebab0a50806ff7fa23281ef71.png

Ciutat de Barcelona Audiovisual and Digital Culture Award
As the video game pioneer, ENDLING also is the very first video game to ever receive Ciutat de Barcelona Audiovisual and Digital Culture Award. The jury described the game as “the success of placing climate change, environmentalism and even care at the center of the narrative and thus incorporating them into the world of video games” and as an “outstanding example of the maturity of video game creation in Barcelona with international recognition”.

GDCA 2023 
Last but not least, ENDLING is amongst the finalists of the GDCA 2023 for the Social Impact Award.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33205595/b9f6f830f3c84c8f55aee3a70f853dd3f43e5236.jpg

We are proud of everyone involved with this project and want to thank everyone of you for all the support!

notes.title: The Nominations Keep Coming In
notes.content:
It's still January and #Endling has been nominated four times at the NAVGTR Awards (The National Academy of Video Game Trade Reviewers):
 
 Outstanding Art Direction, Contemporary
  Outstanding Game, Special Class
  Outstanding Original Dramatic Score, New IP
  Outstanding Game of the Year

https://pbs.twimg.com/media/Fm53OW4X0AA9PS8?format=jpg&name=medium


Two nominations at the Pégases 2023 Awards (Académie des Arts et Techniques du Jeu Vidéo):

 Best International Game
  Best International Indie Game


https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FmG42VEWAAMg0s3?format=jpg&name=large

And it's also nominated as Best Indie Game by Indie Pearls

https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FmsLA6pWAA82Dm1?format=jpg&name=large


What a start to the year! Keep it up 2023 and a big Thank You to everyone involved!

notes.title: Update Notes for Nov 11
notes.content:
- Improved signposting by adding some tutorials and hints
- Corrected some minor localization and other text errors
- Ironed out UI information given to the player
- Fixed softlocks related to jumping in or out of bushes
- Several other bug fixes

notes.title: Update notes for Aug 30
notes.content:
Fixed cubs getting stuck inside the River & Forest lairs on night 28.
 Fixed a crash when learning the cub skill hunt on night 29
 Prevented Dumping Site shortcut from being locked forever.
 Fixed cubs sometimes ignoring their food.
 Fixed getting trapped by guards in Care Corp.
 Tweaked tutorials so that they are not missed that easily.
 More minor bugfixes and tweaks.
